typo.title: Language and typography
typo.intro: How the book is written: spell-check, quotes and spacing. The book’s language code is {code}; exports declare it and hyphenate in it.
typo.language_code_hint: A BCP 47 code, such as fr-CA, it or pt-BR.
typo.spellcheck_detail: Your browser underlines misspellings in the editor, in the book’s language ({code}).
typo.french_spacing_detail: A thin no-break space before ; ! ? and a no-break space before : and inside « ».
typo.dashes_detail: -- becomes an em dash (—); a hyphen between spaces, an en dash (–).
typo.ellipsis_detail: Three dots become one ellipsis character (…).
typo.as_you_type_detail: The editor applies these rules while you write. Ctrl/Cmd+Z puts back what you typed.
typo.apply_at_export_detail: EPUB, PDF, Word, HTML and Markdown files are set with these rules. Your manuscript is not changed.
typo.fix_detail: Apply these rules to the whole manuscript. You see the count first, and a version of each chapter is saved before it changes.
typo.fix_none: Nothing to correct: the manuscript already follows these rules.

typo.fix_apply: Fix {count, plural, one {# correction} other {# corrections}}
typo.fix_done: Fixed {count, plural, one {# correction} other {# corrections}} in {chapters, plural, one {# chapter} other {# chapters}}. A version of each was saved first.
typo.fix_error: That did not work. Nothing was changed; try again.
